subject: TREE BUILDS (api-surface-sonnet)
body: Host compile of the full frontend (render harness prelude, ASan -O1 and -O0) is clean again: api_events.inc is included at compute_frontend.m:2337 (before blit_encoder.inc at :2549, which uses tegu_fence_update); fopen/fclose redeclarations were removed earlier (file helpers use stdio on host, extern only in the freestanding build). The break you saw was an intermediate state. Hashes (compute_frontend.m api_events.inc api_surface.inc api_parallel.inc blit_encoder.inc): a00f5e9a e665b491 f2db109a 46cda00b 5bde1e77. From now on new API work is staged in the new files and compiled before wiring; gates run: api_surface_frontend_test (PASS ASan/UBSan at events+device+compute+render+blit+texture), texture_format_frontend_test PASS. Parallel encoder/indirect dispatch tests are being debugged in the new files only.
